params.name: locationId
params.description: The unique identifier for the location.

params.name: updatedAtStart
params.description: Inclusive RFC 3339 start of the update range. Max 26-hour range, no milliseconds.

params.name: updatedAtEnd
params.description: Exclusive RFC 3339 end of the update range. Must be at least 5 minutes in the past.

params.name: createdAtStart
params.description: Inclusive RFC 3339 start of the creation range. Max 26-hour range, no milliseconds.

params.name: createdAtEnd
params.description: Exclusive RFC 3339 end of the creation range. Must be at least 5 minutes in the past.

params.name: closedAtStart
params.description: Inclusive RFC 3339 start of the closure range. Max 26-hour range, no milliseconds.

params.name: closedAtEnd
params.description: Exclusive RFC 3339 end of the closure range. Must be at least 5 minutes in the past.

params.name: includeUpdatedActivity
params.description: Return previously created or closed orders that were subsequently updated. Only valid with createdAt or closedAt ranges.

items.docs: Retrieve all orders that were last updated, created, or closed within the supplied date/time range for a location. Only orders touched within the last ~90 days are available, and a single date range cannot exceed 26 hours.

params.name: locationId
params.description: The unique identifier for the location.

params.name: orderId
params.description: The unique identifier for the order.

items.docs: Retrieve a single order by its unique identifier for a location.
